text:
Sofia L: Quick RFC follow-up — propose adding a 'layout_hint' to model config so the runtime can pick NHWC / NCHW / INTERLEAVED per-model (or per-request) instead of forcing a global ABI change. Rationale: seq_len/head_count distributions differ a lot across apps.

Ethan R: +1 idea but worried about ABI churn. How do kernels advertise support and how do we avoid breaking fallback paths?

Priya K: We could add a minor ABI bump (v2) exposing capability flags and a simple handshake: kernel.capabilities => ["interleaved", "kv_append", "unaligned_stride_ok"]. Runtime picks best kernel and falls back to planar/NHWC if not supported.

Dave M: Quick bench from internal perf run: A100 bfloat16, head=8 seq=512 -> interleaved qkv ~18% throughput win vs planar. But for head>=48 or odd strides interleaved suffers due to misaligned loads and shared-memory pressure.

Sofia L: That's the crossover effect I was worried about. Suggest runtime heuristic: if head_count <= 16 && seq_len >= 256 => prefer interleaved, else prefer token-major/NHWC. Also consider per-batch distribution (most requests short).

Ethan R: Important: KV-cache semantics. Interleaved layout makes incremental append and read-back tricky (we'd need a KV-view transform). Planar keeps token-major contiguous which is nicer for cache growth.

Priya K: Agree. Proposal: runtime exposes a KV-view abstraction to kernels:
```
// pseudocode capabilities struct
capabilities: {
  supports_interleaved: true,
  supports_kv_append: false,
  preferred_alignment: 64
}
```
Kernels that can't do append opt-out and runtime will insert a cheap transform to planar for caching calls.

Sofia L: Also adding a model config snippet so infra teams can pin behavior per-model:
```json
{
  "model_config": {
    "layout_hint": "auto", // auto | nhwc | nchw | interleaved | token_major
    "layout_fallback": ["nhwc","token_major"]
  }
}
```
Runtime 'auto' uses heuristics + kernel capabilities to select optimal kernel at load time and optionally per-request.

infra-bot: staging: rolled canary kernels with capability flags to canary-cluster-7 :rocket: (deploy id=canary-2026-03-20-07)

Dave M: Action items: 1) add layout_hint to model config PR, 2) spec kernel capability API + handshake, 3) add runtime heuristics tests and microbench harness.

Priya K: I'll take the model-config PR and add a test matrix for common head/seq combos.

Ethan R: I'll write the kernel API proto sketch and a small compatibility shim doc. Dropping a comment in the RFC thread later today.

Sofia L: Nice. Quick note — please include a fallback path that can evict/convert cached KV to planar when we need to switch layouts in-flight (avoid hard errors). Also include perf diffs (p99 latency + tokens/sec).

Dave M: Will capture perf deltas and a short runbook for debugging alignment issues.

Priya K: Sounds good. Marking this as follow-up for the runtime-layout epic. (thumbsup)
